Peng Wang <wang@essb.eur.nl>:
Hi Sara, Many thanks for your help! As this study has not been initialized yet, I have just created an ID for it: 4166. Does it matter for now if we haven’t set up the concrete questions and designs into it? What is the general procedure I have to do with your side for now? I’m new to this app but familiar with the method. A bit confusing but not much. Below is the abstract of the project: This study employs Ecological Momentary Assessment (EMA) to investigate the dynamic relationship between emotions and language learning in authentic settings. Through real-time data collection, the research examines how different emotional states interact and evolve during language learning activities, and how these emotional dynamics influence learning processes over time. The study aims to provide a comprehensive understanding of emotional patterns in language learning, contributing to both theoretical knowledge and practical applications in language education. Thanks for providing me with information in advance. Best Peng

Sara Farnya <sales@avicennaresearch.com>:
Hi Peng,It's my pleasure!Thank you very much for providing the study ID and the abstract. We truly appreciate your contribution.It's perfectly fine if you haven't set up the specific questions and designs yet. We need the study ID only to include it in the license and ensure everything is ready for your project on our end so that you can launch your study whenever you are prepared.Study #4166 has now been added to the EUR license, and everything is set on our side. Please feel free to start adding your questions and configuring your protocol at your convenience. It's best to thoroughly test your study before you begin field deployment. You can find more details here. Just remember to remove any test participants from the study before recruiting real participants.Additionally, to learn more about our research tool, you can visit our documentation website here. Our support team is also available to help you with any technical questions you may have.If you need anything else, please don’t hesitate to let me know.Best,Sara--Avicenna Research (formerly Ethica Data)4109 - 295 Adelaide St W, Toronto, ON M5V 0L4, Canada Email: sales@avicennaresearch.com - Web: https://avicennaresearch.com-- On Wednesday, October 23, 2024 at 2:21:40 PM,
